title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts — Contracts Held by One Customer
content:
A customer may hold Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts on any number of vehicles. No number of contracts per customer is set.

How contracts on one vehicle combine, and how claims combine across one contract's life, is governed by the rule that allows one active contract per vehicle and holds each contract to its own aggregate claim limit.

| Question | Answer under this rule |
|---|---|
| May one customer hold contracts on three different vehicles? | Yes. No per-customer number is set. |
| Does holding several contracts change any one contract's coverage? | This rule sets no such effect. Each contract stands on its own vehicle. |
